simple: Fortinet FortiGate next-generation firewalls — hardware models from desktop units for branches to data-center chassis (built on Fortinet’s own security processors) and virtual FortiGate-VM for private and public clouds; the product here is a FortiGuard subscription bundle that applies to any model. FortiOS itself provides a firewall with application and user control, SSL/TLS decryption, IPsec and SSL VPN for offices and remote workers, and SD-WAN; management via FortiManager or the cloud. The Enterprise Protection bundle is the most complete: An intrusion prevention system (IPS) with deep traffic inspection, antivirus and malware protection including mobile malware, blocking of connections to known botnets, protection against new threat outbreaks (Outbreak Prevention), a cloud sandbox for unknown files (detection only) and SaaS application control (CASB). Web and content filtering by category, secure DNS filtering, video filtering and blocking of botnet command-and-control (C2) channels. Also AI-based inline file inspection against unknown and zero-day threats, data loss prevention (DLP, 500+ sensitive data patterns), assessment of the network configuration against best practices and standards, IoT device detection and a security self-check, plus FortiConverter to migrate rules from other firewalls. Industrial (OT) network protection is sold separately.
